name: Black Projects
description: Project management in your vault: Gantt charts, boards, tables, a KPI dashboard, programmes grouping projects, project templates charted by their links alone, recolourable ticket types and document states, Outlook messages dropped in as tickets, phases, collections gathering chosen tasks across projects, and a versioned document library per project. French interface, working-day scheduling, typed dependencies and working recurring tasks.
author: Black Room Technologies (fork of dotpm, by Stepan Kropachev)
